keep: Clean crisp frames that show only this creature; the transparent background stays empty. Colors, brightness, material finish and lighting stay exactly as in the still in every frame. Existing colored markings remain steady and the same size. The creature keeps its original body proportions and full silhouette inside the canvas. Keep one continuous faceted manta body, exactly two broad fins, one head, one tail and its lower keel. Crystal facets and central core remain solid, attached, and identical in color and brightness.

clips.idle: Hovers calmly in place with tiny synchronized fin movements and a subtle tail flex.
clips.walk: Moves in place through one restrained gliding cycle, two fins flex gently and the single tail follows.
clips.attack: Draws its head back slightly, pushes its leading body edge forward once in the first half, then returns to its original position.
clips.hurt: Recoils slightly backward with a brief fin bend, then steadies in its original pose.
clips.death: Two fins fold inward gently and the intact body lowers and tips onto its side, ending motionless with every crystal facet still attached.
